beats.anchor: Kenzo hésite, puis cogne son poing contre le sien.
beats.extras: Kenzo Delattre, 13: slim white boy with brown curls and very white boots, a proud face trying not to show emotion. Lucas Morel, 13: tall white farm boy with straw-coloured hair, red cheeks and big hands, holding a green apple.
beats.outfit: All the boys in white ESM kits with the star on the chest, after a match. BriBri, his fine shaved part on the left of his head and his braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, holds a folded white ESM shirt with a white star, the number 8 just visible on the fold. Kaydoudou's red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot.
beats.action: In the middle of the locker room, BriBri and Kenzo bump fists. BriBri's other hand is already on his heart; Kenzo, a little awkward, starts to copy him and lifts his free hand toward his own chest. Behind them, Kaydoudou sits on the bench, eyes shining with tears he tries to hide, biting his lip. Lucas, next to him, holds out the apple he kept for Kenzo.
beats.location: The ESM locker room in June: tiled walls, wooden benches, sports bags, boots on the floor, a window open on a sunny evening.
beats.light: Warm golden early-summer evening light through the window, soft on the boys' faces.
beats.camera: Medium shot at chest height, the two fists meeting at the centre of the frame, Kaydoudou and Lucas slightly out of focus on the bench behind.
beats.alt: Dans le vestiaire, BriBri et Kenzo cognent leurs poings, puis Kenzo pose la main sur son cœur comme lui ; Kaydoudou retient ses larmes sur le banc.

beats.extras: Lucas Morel, 13: tall white farm boy with straw-coloured hair, red cheeks, big hands and long legs, finishing a powerful right-foot strike. Kenzo Delattre, 13: slim white boy with brown curls and very white boots, running on the left and laughing. Two 13-year-old ESM teammates in bright yellow training bibs, diving the wrong way to the left. In the distance on the touchline, Monsieur Lacombe, 55, white man, grey brush moustache, navy blue tracksuit, metal whistle.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou, BriBri, Lucas and Kenzo in white ESM training shirts with the star on the chest; the other team in yellow bibs. Kaydoudou's red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot. BriBri's fine shaved part on the left of his head and his braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Frozen instant of the eye feint: Kaydoudou's head and eyes are still turned to the left toward Kenzo, with a sly gap-toothed grin, while the ball he just sent to the right has flown off Lucas's boot into the top corner of the net. The two yellow bibs have thrown themselves to the left, fooled. BriBri, behind, raises both arms. The net bulges.
beats.location: The ESM synthetic pitch by the river Marne at the end of June, a row of tall poplars, a flat barge loaded with sand far away on the water.
beats.light: Orange sunset light, as if mango juice had been poured over the sky, long shadows across the turf.
beats.camera: Dynamic wide angle from behind Kaydoudou, his looking-left face in the foreground, the ball's trail crossing the frame to the top corner on the right.
beats.alt: Kaydoudou regarde Kenzo à gauche, mais le ballon est parti à droite : Lucas frappe de toutes ses forces et le ballon se loge dans la lucarne.

beats.anchor: Au même moment, la route sort d'un virage.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in his sun-yellow T-shirt with a red vertical stripe on the left of the chest, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot. BriBri in a faded green T-shirt, his fine shaved part on the left of his head, his braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, the thick notebook covered in green and orange wax cloth open on his knees with a pencil (writing too small to read). Papa Armand driving, tall, short neat beard, light blue shirt. Maman Estelle, braids gathered in a bun, big gold earrings, a duck-blue and yellow wax dress.
beats.action: The rental car comes out of a bend and the Mediterranean suddenly fills the windows. Papa and Maman cry out together, pointing. Kaydoudou, face pressed to the window, smiles calmly like someone who saw it first. BriBri, notebook on his knees, turns toward his brother with a surprised, admiring look.
beats.location: A winding coastal road in Catalonia at dawn in late August: rocky coves, pine trees, a sparkling blue sea below, a small white car on the road.
beats.light: Early morning sun rising on the left over the sea, golden light pouring into the car, the sea glittering like a party tablecloth.
beats.camera: Wide shot from outside and slightly above, the small car in the bend on the right, the faces visible through the side windows, the huge shining sea opening on the left.
beats.alt: La voiture sort d'un virage et la mer surgit, immense et scintillante ; Kaydoudou sourit à la vitre, il l'avait vue avant tout le monde.
